workflows.trigger: explicit request for one draft from selected direct-session messages memories or both
workflows.definitionsAndChoice: required write_lorebook_entry plus optional no_entry unless force removes it
workflows.modelResolution: configured text-capable entry-generator model or first credentialed text-capable model
workflows.promptContext: character persona session target lorebook existing entries direction selected messages selected memories and optional memory summary
workflows.multipleCalls: write_lorebook_entry wins over an earlier no_entry result
workflows.mutationBoundary: returns a normalized draft and does not persist the lorebook
workflows.retry: one native attempt then one configured JSON or XML fallback

workflows.trigger: explicit request with nonblank entry content
workflows.promptContext: title content existing keywords and direction
workflows.mutationBoundary: returns at most twenty-four case-insensitively deduplicated keywords
workflows.retry: one native attempt then one configured JSON or XML fallback

workflows.trigger: explicit nonblank brief plus bounded text markdown or PDF sources
workflows.definitionsAndChoice: required planner writer and coherence tools in separate workflow stages
workflows.modelResolution: job override then configured lorebook-generator model then application default
workflows.promptContext: planner digest outline per-entry source excerpts draft feedback and complete draft set depending on stage
workflows.multipleCalls: each stage reads the first matching required tool result; drafting runs up to three entry requests concurrently
workflows.mutationBoundary: in-memory outline drafts revisions and coherence proposals until commit
workflows.finalization: commit creates or targets one lorebook then inserts every nonblank draft

boundaryDecisions.decision: lettuce-creation owns durable reviewed generation jobs and proposals while lettuce-context owns validated lorebook drafts revisions and atomic mutation use cases
replace the process-local registry with durable stage attempts checkpoints errors cancellation and restart recovery
commands enforce legal stage transitions and stable plan and draft identities
commit only explicitly accepted drafts through one expected-revision lorebook change set and one transaction
remove permissive free-text tool inference and validate native and structured fallback results against exact declarations
large sources use protected asset references and bounded extracted snapshots instead of base64 in workflow state or ordinary events
single-entry keyword and staged workflows all settle cancellation and recover durable attempts idempotently

includes: stable outline and draft proposal identities
outline review draft review and coherence review transitions

scenarios.expected: message-only generation rejects an empty or unresolved selection
memory-only generation rejects when neither selected memory nor included summary has content
a selected message memory or included summary is sufficient
message ids from another conversation cannot enter the prompt snapshot
no_entry returns a reason and no draft
the declared request contains only write_lorebook_entry and absence is failure
invalid draft arguments do not produce a proposal
first spelling wins and no more than twenty-four keywords remain
generation returns a proposal only
fallback cannot introduce no_entry in force mode or undeclared operations
each source is at most fifty megabytes total input is at most two hundred megabytes and extracted excerpts are at most twenty thousand characters
empty provider outline fails planning
draft records are created only after a nonempty outline is approved
at most three pending or failed entries are requested concurrently
a failed entry retains identity and may be selected by the next draft batch
feedback and resulting content append an immutable draft revision
only selected merge rename or toggle proposals mutate draft proposals; contradiction flags remain review information
planning approval drafting refinement coherence and commit commands reject invalid source stages
outline edits and parallel completion cannot retarget a draft or coherence change
pending failed and merely drafted entries are excluded from final apply
book creation or expected-revision update and all accepted entries commit once or not at all
cancellation settles active attempts without deleting the workflow and reviewed proposals
completed drafts remain complete and interrupted draft executions resume without duplication
binary ingestion follows after protected asset and extraction ports exist
